}}'''Sigmont''' is a soldier of the [[Tower Guard]].{{ref/book|14|36}}

== Appearance ==
[[Mat Cauthon]] reckons Sigmont is not a day over fifteen.

== Activities ==
Mat teaches Sigmont and some other recruits how to use some basic quarterstaff techniques, though Sigmont wishes to learn sword techniques instead.

== Trivia ==
* Sigmont is named for Jason Zigmont, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
